title: Shared/private dictionary + Mirror coefficients
hypothesis: A shared functional basis plus small Mirror coordinates will represent aligned functions economically, while allocating private residual atoms only to off-manifold functions will improve the quality-byte frontier over all-shared or all-private storage.
physical_object: one shared 32D base function and four shared residual atoms, with optional per-function private residual vectors
mirror_coordinate: four shared-basis coefficients; residual is private only when thresholded reconstruction error requires it
controls: shared basis + private residual for every function

development.allowed: select one residual threshold from [0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4] on development only

success_gate: For every fresh world and heterogeneity level, adaptive shared/private has NRMSE <=0.05 and payload <=80% all-independent dense, with private fraction below 100%; beat shared-only quality-byte tradeoff.
failure_gate: Adaptive allocation misses quality/bytes, or private state consumes the saved storage; report threshold and heterogeneity boundary.
boundaries: Synthetic linear functions and known shared basis only.
No learned neural experts or task routing claim.
Private residual bytes are fully charged.
